build_engine_game: build a pycolab game engine with specified rows and cols for a grid-based ASCII game
create_backdrop_game: create a backdrop for the engine using characters and a Backdrop subclass to paint the game board background
add_sprite_game: add a sprite to the engine at a given position with a character and Sprite subclass for game entities
run_game_episode: run a game episode by calling its_showtime then play with actions to get observations, rewards, and discounts
create_palette_chars: create a palette helper to map legal ASCII characters to their ordinal values for game board rendering
